note: SYNTHETIC data. reference_sql hard-codes the month (2026-09, the latest in the sample) so it is computed independently of the SQL under test. expected is the reference result rounded to 4 dp, pasted; the eval re-runs reference_sql and fails if the two ever drift.

questions.question: How many incidents were opened last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE opened_at LIKE '2026-09-%'

questions.question: What was the MTTR in hours by severity last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT severity, SUM(minutes_to_restore) / 60.0 / COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE opened_at LIKE '2026-09-%' GROUP BY severity

questions.question: What share of incidents were SEV1 last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'SEV1' AND opened_at LIKE '2026-09-%') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE opened_at LIKE '2026-09-%')

questions.question: Which team had the most incidents last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM incidents i, services s, teams t WHERE i.service = s.service AND s.team_id = t.team_id AND i.opened_at LIKE '2026-09-%' GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Mean time to restore by service tier last month
questions.reference_sql: SELECT s.tier, AVG(i.minutes_to_restore) / 60.0 FROM incidents i JOIN services s USING (service) WHERE i.opened_at LIKE '2026-09-%' GROUP BY s.tier
